senses.gloss: ch. same, to boil, be hot.—Part. pass. רָתִיחַ; pl. רְתִיחִין.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 50:1">Targ. Y. I Gen. L, 1</cite> <he>חמרין רתי׳</he> (some ed. <he>רָתְחִין</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 24:24">Targ. Job XXIV, 24</cite> Ms.—Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ top <he>דלא יִרְתְּחָן ויחמען</he> that they may not get hot and ferment.
Ber. 62ᵇ עד דרַתְחָא וכ׳, v. קִדְרָא; a. e.—רָתְחִין hot water.
Ex. R. s. 45 מזגין ר׳ (not רתחים), v. מְזַג; Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV, 4.—Trnsf. to be excited, wroth.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 39:4">Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 19:6">Targ. Y. Deut. XIX, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 7:9">Targ. Koh. VII, 9</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:15">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>רגע ר׳</he> for a moment the Lord is wroth.
<cite ref="Berakhot 29b:16">Ib. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>לא תִרְתַּח ולא תחטי</he> be not excited, and thou shalt not sin.
<cite ref="Zevachim 30b:17">Zeb. 30ᵇ</cite> hot. <he>אם כן מִרְתַּח ר׳</he> if so, he might get angry; a. e.

senses.gloss: to boil; to heat, excite, arouse the anger of.
units: Targ. Job XLI, 23 מַרְתַּח (some ed. מְרַתַּח Pa.). Targ. Koh. l. c. מסרב ומַרְתַּח (ed. Vien. ומִרְ׳, corr. acc.; some ed. ומְרַתַּח).—[Targ. Job IV, 10 מרתיחין, v. רְתַת.]—
<cite ref="Pesachim 76a:2">Pes. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>רוטב מַרְתַּח ליה וכ׳</he> (or <he>מְרַתַּח</he>) the juice (dripping) heats the clay (of the oven) &c.
Taan. 4ᵃ ההוא … דקא מַרְתְּחָא ליה (or מְרַתְּחָא) if a student gets angry, it is the (zeal for) the Law that excites him; a. e.—Part. pass. Pa. מְרַתַּח; f. מְרַתְּחָא.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 6:14">Targ. Y. I Lev. VI, 14</cite> <cite ref="M02787"><he>מְרֻתְּחָא</he></cite> (Hebraism; h. text <he>מרבכת</he>).—
<cite ref="Gittin 57b:2">Gitt. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>אשכחיה … מר׳ וסליק</he> he found the blood of Zechariah bubbling and coming up; (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96b:5">Snh. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>דהוה קא רתח</he>).
